title: Cultural activists protest at Thiruvananthapuram Corporation over denial of permission to Manaveeyam Veedhi event

ai.summary: Cultural activists protested at Thiruvananthapuram Corporation after being denied permission for a cultural event at Manaveeyam Veedhi, with police detaining six activists including veteran theatre artist D. Raghoothaman.

facts.claim: Cultural activists protested at Thiruvananthapuram Corporation after being denied permission for a cultural event at Manaveeyam Veedhi
facts.quote: Following the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)-led Thiruvananthapuram Corporation’s denial of permission for a cultural programme at Manaveeyam Veedhi featuring singer Pushpavathy, a group of cultural activists representing various organisations at Manaveeyam staged a protest at the Corporation office on Monday.

facts.claim: police detaining six activists including veteran theatre artist D. Raghoothaman
facts.quote: The police dragged out of the Corporation office the six activists, including veteran theatre artist D. Raghoothaman, Vinod Vaisakhi, S.Rahul, K.G.Suraj, Diya Sana and S.S.Deepu.

ai.background_note: Cultural activists in Thiruvananthapuram protested after local government denied permission for a cultural event at Manaveeyam Veedhi, a public space with 25 years of history used for cultural expression.
